headline.text: L1 S4 caramel scrapped on *black specs* — kettles caustic cleaned, plus three equipment-integrity flags across L1 and L3.

summary: Four food-safety events today: L1 S4 black specs in caramel required full scrap and caustic clean of kettles; L3 ML1 Cavanna tooth failure; L3 TL Spreading Table belt strip came loose mid-run; L1 S2 non-approved scissors removed from bottomer area. No active holds at window close.

food_safety.title: Black specs in caramel — S4 product scrapped, kettles caustic cleaned
food_safety.summary: Production found black specs in caramel at depositor and reserve; all caramel drained from tunnel and reserve, kettles inspected and found dirty, caustic clean completed before resuming cook.
food_safety.status: Resolved — kettles cleaned and ready to cook as of 09:29.

food_safety.title: Cavanna tooth broke off at ML1
food_safety.summary: Equipment tooth fell out at Cavanna flow-wrap; maintenance replaced damaged pivot, line resumed.

food_safety.title: Non-approved scissors removed from S2 bottomer area
food_safety.summary: Plant Standards walk found unapproved scissors in production zone at S2; immediately confiscated.

food_safety.title: Spreading Table belt strip came loose mid-run — Truffle Line
food_safety.summary: Belt strip detached and hung beneath Spreading Table; QA verified no FM concerns, crew manually guided chocolate lanes to finish Hershey order, then replaced belt strip after cleaning and ATP.
food_safety.status: Resolved — replacement strip installed and ATP passed as of 09:54.

opportunities.text: Consider adding kettle visual inspection to S4 pre-cook checklist — today's black specs traced to dirty kettles that passed into production.
Review Cavanna and Spreading Table PM schedules — two separate equipment-part failures (tooth, belt strip) on ML1 and TL in one shift suggest wear inspection gaps.
